findings.claim: A throwing onData callback during per-chunk draining aborts WasmBridge.writeRaw, dropping all later bytes in the same terminal write and skipping render scheduling.
findings.evidence: Built DOM plus committed WASM: chunk one contained 8188 A bytes plus CPR and chunk two contained CSI H plus Z. With onData throwing, the write threw and cell 0,0 stayed A/cursor 23,28; with a non-throwing consumer, cell 0,0 became Z/cursor 0,1.
findings.layer: end-to-end PTY write and application callback path
findings.path: WTerm.write -> WasmBridge.writeRaw chunk 1 -> afterChunk -> _drainResponses -> onData throws -> chunk 2 unreachable

findings.claim: The public TerminalCore/WasmBridge afterChunk callback is absent from both required public API method tables.
findings.evidence: TerminalCore and WasmBridge expose writeString(str, afterChunk?) and writeRaw(data, afterChunk?), while packages/@wterm/core/README.md and apps/docs/src/app/api-reference/page.mdx still show one-argument signatures and do not describe callback timing or failure behavior.
findings.path: TerminalCore/WasmBridge public signatures -> package README and web API reference
